text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now then Trainer-san, feast your eyes on 
this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's Matikane Fukukitaru's Super Lucky 
Final Form! ...-esque outfit!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ta-da!
choice_data_list: That's a pretty normal racing outfit.
That's a pretty standard racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"No faaaair! I went through all the 
trouble of wearing this, so you could at 
least act a little more impressed!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well, having said that, this outfit is 
still... missing that final finishing 
touch.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It means it's not filled with spiritual 
energy! Without good fortune, it's just an 
empty vessel.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And so, let's go recharge our spiritual 
energy! To one of the most powerful power 
spots in the entire academy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Deep down the hallway, a sign hung with 
the words—"Student Council Room."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this room is a sacred power spot 
accessible only to the chosen few!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"And right at the very back of this 
student council room lies that sacred 
artifact."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, that enshrined 'paper' is what gives 
us the ultimate power!”

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Reading these written blessings before a 
race... gets my motivation bursting right 
out of my nostrils!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now then... There's nobody here, right? 
Right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: If you'll excuse me, I'll head inside...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gyahin!? Please don't say things that make 
me sound bad~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"This is, um... silent shrine-praying! 
It's a ritual to stay beneath the gods' 
notice!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Is that kinda idea no good? Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I beg of you! Could you please 
just turn a blind eye here? Pretty please?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, much obliged! That means from here 
on out we're two peas in a pod, and you're 
an accomplice too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Found it! This is it, this one! The 
"School Motto" that describes what an 
Umamusume should strive to be!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Written on the paper inside the frame on 
the wall were these words: "Eclipse first, 
the rest nowhere."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, truly a masterpiece of prose... Let us 
soak up this spiritual energy to our 
heart's content before heading back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Receiving guidance from Tracen Academy, 
Matikanefukukitaru looked quite satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now then, once I take what I came for, I 
shall withdraw...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey. ...You've got quite the nerve 
trespassing like this.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're...!? The Student Council Vice 
President, Narita Brian-san!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No, you've got it wrong! It was just a 
momentary impulse. I meant no harm, so 
please overlook it this once...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Alright, no good.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gyahiii, a no-look judgment~!? How is her 
reflex so sharp~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I got thoroughly chewed out. 
But the goal of infusing power into the 
racing racewear was successfully achieved.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What?! Are you being serious, Trainer? 
Even the smallest worm has a soul, as they 
sa—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, don't pull on me—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I got permission once more from 
Vice President Air Groove and was allowed 
into the room.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, this is it, this is the one! The 
"School Motto" describing the ideal image 
Umamusume strive for!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This is the god-tier paper that gives me 
power! Ah, was that a pretty good pun just 
now?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Eclipse first, the rest nowhere." Ooh~, 
that gives me chills~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
By the way, what's "Eclipse"? Like some 
kind of daily tear-off calendar?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Haa, you really are something... Did you 
not understand a single word of my 
instructions?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to reforge both your heart and 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine, really! Even if I don't get 
it at all, I can just vibe with it!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, kneel right there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, she was thoroughly lectured. 
Even so, it seemed she learned a great 
deal from Air Groove's teachings.
